title: From Hand to Mouth
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.prompt: “The main reasons why there is a lack of food in southern Africa year after year”
questions.translation: southern Africa 年復一年缺糧的主要原因。

blocks.text: 這是 Matching Information。題目要求找出哪一段集中解釋「長期、反覆」缺糧原因。控制詞是
“year after year”，所以要找 chronic、recurs、repeated problem 這類意思。
目標段落：Paragraph C第一句：“Though the problem is particularly severe this year, it recurs across southern Africa.”
雖然今年問題特別嚴重，但這個問題在 southern Africa 反覆出現。
“And the region has the world’s highest rate of AIDS.”
而且該地區有全球最高的 AIDS 比率。
只看首尾句，C 段已經清楚指向「長期反覆的原因」。第一句有 recurs，直接對應 year after year；尾句加入 AIDS，顯示這段會列出多個結構性因素。
題目中最有定位力的詞是：
“Food is produced mainly by subsistence farmers on small plots with no irrigation; their fate is tied to rain falling in the right amount at the right time.”
糧食主要由在小塊土地上耕作的自給農民生產，而且沒有灌溉；他們的命運取決於雨水是否在正確時間、以正確分量落下。
“Bad roads and unreliable transport make it expensive to move food and seeds.”
惡劣道路和不可靠運輸令糧食和種子的運送成本變高。
“Without proper marketing channels, small farmers cannot sell whatever surplus they may have outside their neighbourhoods.”
沒有適當銷售渠道，小農即使有剩餘作物，也無法賣到鄰近地區以外。
“Maize is ill-suited to the climate, needing too much water.”
玉米不適合該地氣候，因為它需要太多水。
“main reasons why there is a lack of food”
原文： no irrigation / bad roads / unreliable transport / no marketing channels / maize needing too much water / too many people for the land / low yields / AIDS判斷： Paragraph C 集中列出長期糧食短缺的根本原因，所以答案是 C。
Paragraph B 也講 drought、late rain、seeds、fertiliser 和高糧價，但它主要說今年危機的規模和即時觸發因素。Question 1 的 “year after year” 指向長期重複問題，C 段更精準。

questions.prompt: “How small development schemes can help to solve the problem”
questions.translation: 小型發展計劃如何幫助解決問題。

blocks.text: “Harnessing what the region already has would go a long way to offsetting its chronic hunger.”
善用該地區已經擁有的資源，將能大大抵消長期飢餓問題。
“A few kilometres down the road, the land is hopelessly dry and barren.”
幾公里外，土地卻乾枯荒蕪，幾乎沒有希望。
只看首尾句，F 段會用對比展示：有水利管理的地方可以綠化和增產，缺乏水利的地方仍然乾旱。
題目中的 small development schemes 很可能對應中間的小型 irrigation scheme。
“On a smaller but no less hopeful scale”

“On a smaller but no less hopeful scale, the nearby Chitsukwa irrigation scheme cost only about $20,000 and provided canals and enough low-tech pumps to water 18 hectares (45 acres), which sustain 176 farmers.”
在較小但同樣有希望的規模上，附近的 Chitsukwa 灌溉計劃只花約 20,000 美元，提供了水渠和足夠的低技術水泵，可灌溉 18 公頃，即 45 英畝，並支持 176 名農民。
“Now armed with better knowledge, farmers are aiming at three crops a year, instead of the precarious single one to which they were accustomed.”
現在，農民有了更好的知識，目標是一年三造，而過去他們習慣的是風險很高的一造。

small development schemes= Chitsukwa irrigation scheme / smaller scale / low-tech pumps help to solve the problem= water 18 hectares / sustain 176 farmers / three crops a year判斷： Paragraph F 展示小型灌溉計劃如何用低成本提高農業穩定性，所以答案是 F。

questions.prompt: “The things that some desperate farmers do to feed themselves and their families”
questions.translation: 一些絕望農民為了養活自己和家人所做的事情。

blocks.text: “Many small farmers struggle to make ends meet even in good years, so one bad season can be disastrous.”
很多小農即使在好年份也只能勉強維持生活，所以一個壞季節已可能造成災難。
“Others venture into crocodile-infested rivers to dig out water-lily tubers for food.”
另一些人冒險進入有鱷魚出沒的河流，挖水蓮塊莖充飢。
只看首尾句，D 段已經顯示農民在壞季節後走到非常危險的地步。題目中的 desperate farmers和 feed themselves 直接對應此段尾句。
“Unable to grow enough to feed themselves”
“Unable to grow enough to feed themselves or borrow their way out of hard times, farmers end up losing the few assets they have.”
農民無法種出足夠糧食養活自己，也無法靠借貸渡過困境，最後失去僅有的資產。

“In Malawi, those without anything left often resort to cutting and selling firewood, further eroding the soil and making their plots still less productive, or else fishing in already depleted waters.”
在 Malawi，一無所有的人常常轉而砍柴和賣柴，進一步侵蝕土壤，使田地更不肥沃；或者在已經枯竭的水域捕魚。
“Others venture into crocodile-infested rivers to dig out water-lily tubers for food.”
另一些人冒險進入有鱷魚出沒的河流，挖水蓮塊莖作食物。

desperate farmers= those without anything left / unable to grow enough things they do= cutting and selling firewood / fishing / digging water-lily tubers feed themselves and their families= to feed themselves / for food判斷： Paragraph D 專門描述農民失去選擇後的求生方法，所以答案是 D。

questions.prompt: “The size and cost of the problem in southern Africa”
questions.translation: southern Africa 糧食問題的規模和成本。

blocks.text: “Aid agencies are sounding the alarm, hoping that help will come before haunting images of emaciated children, such as those recently seen in Niger, appear on Western television screens.”
援助機構正在發出警報，希望援助能在西方電視出現像 Niger 近期那種消瘦兒童畫面之前到來。
“Maize, the staple food, is scarce in some areas; prices in markets have shot up beyond the means of the hungriest.”
玉米這種主食在一些地區很稀缺；市場價格已急升到最飢餓的人也負擔不起。
只看首尾句，B 段會描述危機規模和即時嚴重性。題目中的 size and cost 很可能在中間以人數、金額和時間出現。
“The UN’s World Food Programme (WFP) says that close to 12 million people across southern Africa will need food aid before the next harvest.”
聯合國世界糧食計劃署表示，在下一次收成前，southern Africa 近 1,200 萬人將需要糧食援助。
“The agency is short of more than $150 million to feed them over the next six months.”
該機構在未來六個月餵飽這些人方面，仍短缺超過 1.5 億美元。
size of the problem= close to 12 million people cost of the problem= short of more than $150 million判斷： Paragraph B 同時給出受影響人數和所需資金，所以答案是 B。

questions.prompt: “The January rains are described as ‘crucial’ because 5 _________________ need the water.”
questions.translation: 一月的雨被形容為「關鍵」，因為 5 ________ 需要水。

blocks.text: 這是句子填空，限制是 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。空格前後顯示答案應是複數名詞短語，作為 need water 的主語。
“Aid agencies are sounding the alarm, hoping that help will come before haunting images of emaciated children, such as those recently seen in Niger, appear on Western television screens.”
援助機構正在發出警報，希望援助能在西方電視出現消瘦兒童畫面之前到來。
“Maize, the staple food, is scarce in some areas; prices in markets have shot up beyond the means of the hungriest.”
玉米這種主食在一些地區稀缺；市場價格已急升至最飢餓的人也負擔不起。
B 段處理當前危機的即時因素，包括 rain、seeds、fertiliser 和 food prices。題目有 January rains，直接指向此段中間。
原文直接有 “The crucial rains of January, when newly planted crops need water...”
“The crucial rains of January, when newly planted crops need water, did not come on time.”
一月的關鍵雨水，即新種下的作物需要水的時候，沒有按時到來。
字數檢查： newly planted crops = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
“are described as ‘crucial’ because ... need the water”
“crucial rains of January, when newly planted crops need water”
判斷：答案是 newly planted crops。

questions.prompt: “Maize is an unsuitable crop in much of southern Africa because it requires 6_________________”
questions.translation: 玉米在 southern Africa 很多地方都不適合種植，因為它需要 6 ________。

blocks.text: “Though the problem is particularly severe this year, it recurs across southern Africa.”
雖然今年問題特別嚴重，但它在 southern Africa 反覆出現。
“And the region has the world’s highest rate of AIDS.”
而且該地區有全球最高的 AIDS 比率。
C 段會列出長期缺糧原因。題目有 Maize 和 unsuitable crop，這正好對應 C 段中間關於氣候和玉米的句子。
“Maize is ill-suited to the climate, needing too much water.”
“ill-suited” 對應 unsuitable；“needing” 對應 requires。
原文關鍵句：“Maize is ill-suited to the climate, needing too much water.”
玉米不適合該氣候，因為它需要太多水。
字數檢查： too much water = 3 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
unsuitable= ill-suited requires= needing判斷：答案是 too much water。

questions.prompt: “In Zimbabwe, much agricultural produce cannot be moved because of 7 _________________”
questions.translation: 在 Zimbabwe，很多農產品無法運輸，原因是 7 ________。

blocks.text: “Bad government policy sometimes makes things worse.”
糟糕的政府政策有時會令情況惡化。
世界銀行將提供 3,000 萬美元。
E 段先講 Zimbabwe 政策如何令農業和糧食問題惡化，再講 Malawi 和國際援助。題目明確提到Zimbabwe，答案應在 E 段前半。
“crop transport” 對應 agricultural produce moved；“stymie” 表示阻礙。
原文關鍵句：“Hyperinflation and lack of foreign exchange make it hard to buy seeds and fertiliser, while fuel shortages stymie crop transport.”
惡性通脹和外匯短缺令購買種子和肥料變得困難，而燃料短缺阻礙作物運輸。
字數檢查： fuel shortages = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
cannot be moved= crop transport is stymied because of= while fuel shortages...判斷：答案是 fuel shortages。
同一句也有 hyperinflation 和 lack of foreign exchange，但它們影響的是 buying seeds and fertiliser。題目問 agricultural produce cannot be moved，定案詞是 crop transport。

questions.prompt: “8 _________________ can be used instead of irrigation canals to water crops.”

blocks.text: “Harnessing what the region already has would go a long way to offsetting its chronic hunger.”
善用該地區已經擁有的資源，將能大大抵消長期飢餓。
“A few kilometres down the road, the land is hopelessly dry and barren.”
幾公里外，土地卻乾枯荒蕪，幾乎沒有希望。
F 段集中處理 irrigation 和小型水利方案。題目問灌溉作物的工具，應在 Chitsukwa scheme 的設備描述中尋找。
“provided canals and enough low-tech pumps to water 18 hectares”

“On a smaller but no less hopeful scale, the nearby Chitsukwa irrigation scheme cost only about $20,000 and provided canals and enough low-tech pumps to water 18 hectares (45 acres), which sustain 176 farmers.”
附近的 Chitsukwa 灌溉計劃只花約 20,000 美元，提供了水渠和足夠的低技術水泵，可灌溉 18公頃，即 45 英畝，並支持 176 名農民。
空格句需要一個複數名詞作主語。原文中能直接配合 “can be used ... to water crops” 的詞是low-tech pumps。
字數檢查： low-tech pumps = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
water crops= water 18 hectares / pumping water into their fields答案是 low-tech pumps。
小提醒：題目中的 “instead of irrigation canals” 比原文略強。原文說這個 scheme “provided canals and enough low-tech pumps”，即水渠和水泵一同出現。按空格定位和可填入原文短語來看，預期答案仍是 low-tech pumps。

questions.prompt: “Some farmers didn’t get seeds to plant this season.”
questions.translation: 有些農民今季沒有得到種子來播種。

blocks.text: “Aid agencies are sounding the alarm, hoping that help will come before haunting images of emaciated children, such as those recently seen in Niger, appear on Western television screens.”
援助機構正在發出警報，希望援助在消瘦兒童畫面出現於西方電視之前到來。
“Maize, the staple food, is scarce in some areas; prices in markets have shot up beyond the means of the hungriest.”
玉米這種主食在一些地區稀缺；市場價格已急升至最飢餓的人也負擔不起。
B 段處理當季危機因素，包括雨水、種子、肥料和糧價。題目有 seeds，所以 B 段最可能。
“Nor, in some places, did seeds and fertiliser.”
這句要連回上一句 “did not come on time”。
“The crucial rains of January, when newly planted crops need water, did not come on time. Nor, in some places, did seeds and fertiliser.”
一月的關鍵雨水，即新種下的作物需要水的時候，沒有按時到來。在一些地方，種子和肥料也沒有按時到來。

題目命題：主體：some farmers內容：didn’t get seeds時間：to plant this season原文命題：地點範圍：in some places內容：seeds and fertiliser did not come on time語境：newly planted crops / January rains / this growing season比較結果：原文說一些地方的 seeds 沒有按時到，支援題目中 Some farmers didn’t get seeds 的說法。
Some farmers= in some places didn’t get seeds= seeds did not come on time to plant this season= newly planted crops / January rains 的種植季節語境判斷：題目和原文方向一致，所以答案是 TRUE。

questions.prompt: “Poor infrastructure means that parts of Mozambique are without food while other parts have plenty.”
questions.translation: 基礎設施差，導致 Mozambique 有些地區缺糧，但其他地區糧食充足。

blocks.text: “Though the problem is particularly severe this year, it recurs across southern Africa.”
雖然今年問題特別嚴重，但它在 southern Africa 反覆出現。
“And the region has the world’s highest rate of AIDS.”
而且該地區有全球最高的 AIDS 比率。
C 段列出長期缺糧原因，其中包括 road、transport 和 marketing channels。題目提到infrastructure 和 Mozambique，所以可定位到 C 段中間。
“Bad roads and unreliable transport make it expensive to move food and seeds.”
惡劣道路和不可靠運輸令糧食和種子的運送成本變高。
“Without proper marketing channels, small farmers cannot sell whatever surplus they may have outside their neighbourhoods.”
沒有適當銷售渠道，小農無法把剩餘作物賣到鄰近地區以外。
“This leaves southern Mozambicans hungry, even when crops are plentiful up north.”
這導致 Mozambique 南部居民挨餓，即使北部作物充足。

Poor infrastructure= bad roads / unreliable transport / no proper marketing channels parts of Mozambique are without food= southern Mozambicans hungry other parts have plenty= crops are plentiful up north判斷：原文明確說南部缺糧、北部作物充足，原因和道路、運輸、銷售渠道有關。答案是 TRUE。

questions.prompt: “Southern Africa does not have many of the resources it needs to help solve its food problem.”
questions.translation: Southern Africa 並沒有很多能幫助解決糧食問題的資源。

blocks.text: “Harnessing what the region already has would go a long way to offsetting its chronic hunger.”
善用該地區已經擁有的資源，將能大大抵消長期飢餓問題。
“A few kilometres down the road, the land is hopelessly dry and barren.”
幾公里外，土地卻乾枯荒蕪，幾乎沒有希望。
只看首句，F 段的方向已經很清楚：該地區其實擁有可利用的資源，只是尚未善用。這和題目說缺乏很多所需資源的方向相衝。
“Harnessing what the region already has would go a long way to offsetting its chronic hunger.”
善用該地區已經擁有的資源，將能大大抵消其長期飢餓問題。
“In southern Malawi, rivers regularly flood—and are badly managed.”
在 Malawi 南部，河流經常氾濫，而且管理很差。
這表示問題的核心不一定是完全缺資源；水源其實存在，甚至會氾濫，問題在於管理和灌溉利用不足。Paragraph G 也說 Malawi lacks know-how and money，這代表仍有技術和資金限制，但Question 11 說的是 southern Africa 缺乏 many resources。F 段首句已經指出該地區有現成資源可善用。
“does not have many of the resources it needs”
“what the region already has would go a long way”
比較結果：題目說資源缺乏；原文強調已有資源若被善用，便能大幅改善情況。
判斷：原文提供相反方向，所以答案是 FALSE。
Paragraph G 說 Malawi lacks the know-how and money，這只表示某些條件不足，尤其是知識和資金。Question 11 把範圍擴大成 southern Africa 缺乏很多所需資源，與 Paragraph F 的整體方向不符。

questions.prompt: “Zimbabwe’s government policies have actually helped neighbouring countries in one way.”
questions.translation: Zimbabwe 的政府政策在某一方面實際上幫助了鄰近國家。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph E 和 Paragraph G，需要跨段理解。
“Bad government policy sometimes makes things worse.”
糟糕的政府政策有時會令情況惡化。
“Uladi Mussa, Malawi’s minister for agriculture and food security, insists that expanding small-scale irrigation is a top priority.”
Malawi 農業及糧食安全部長 Uladi Mussa 堅持，擴大小型灌溉是首要任務。
題目同時包含 Zimbabwe’s government policies 和 neighbouring countries helped，所以要先看E 段的 Zimbabwe 政策，再掃描後文是否出現鄰國受益。
“Zambia and Mozambique have both welcomed exiled white Zimbabwean farmers”
“whose skills are already boosting local agriculture”
“In Zimbabwe, once the region’s breadbasket, land grabs have crippled commercial agriculture and irrigation systems.”
Zimbabwe 曾是該地區的糧倉，但土地搶奪已重創商業農業和灌溉系統。
“Zambia and Mozambique have both welcomed exiled white Zimbabwean farmers, whose skills are already boosting local agriculture.”
Zambia 和 Mozambique 都歡迎被迫離開 Zimbabwe 的白人農民，而這些人的技術已經在提升當地農業。
題目說 policies have actually helped neighbouring countries “in one way”。這個 “one way” 對應G 段：Zimbabwe 農民流亡到 Zambia 和 Mozambique，他們的農業技術提升了當地農業。雖然 E段強調 Zimbabwe 政策本身造成嚴重破壞，但跨段看，這些政策產生的流亡農民在鄰國帶來技術收益。

Zimbabwe’s government policies= land grabs / bad government policy in Zimbabwe neighbouring countries= Zambia and Mozambique helped in one way= skills are already boosting local agriculture判斷：文章支援這個短距離跨段推論，所以答案是 TRUE。
E 段整體語氣非常負面，學生可能以為任何關於 Zimbabwe policy 的正面說法都不可能成立。題目加了 “in one way”，範圍很窄；它只問鄰國是否在某方面受益，而 G 段確實說 exiled farmers 的skills 正在提升當地農業。

questions.prompt: “About half of Malawi’s children aged under 5 are malnourished.”
questions.translation: Malawi 約一半五歲以下兒童營養不良。

blocks.text: “Uladi Mussa, Malawi’s minister for agriculture and food security, insists that expanding small-scale irrigation is a top priority.”
Malawi 農業及糧食安全部長 Uladi Mussa 堅持，擴大小型灌溉是首要任務。
“For them, the damage will remain long after the rains have come.”
對他們來說，即使雨水回來後，傷害仍會持續很久。
Paragraph G 後半談 chronic hunger 對下一代的影響。題目提到 children under 5，所以目標是 G段後半。
“Close to half of Malawi’s children under five are stunted.”
“Close to half of Malawi’s children under five are stunted.”
Malawi 五歲以下兒童中，接近一半發育遲滯。
“Schools unable to feed their pupils report drops in attendance, as children are too weak to walk or are forced to help their parents find food.”
無法為學生提供食物的學校報告出席率下降，因為孩子太虛弱，無法步行上學，或被迫幫父母尋找食物。
題目把 “stunted” 改寫成 “malnourished”。在這篇文章的語境中，Paragraph G 前一句說 chronic hunger is threatening future generations，後文又說兒童太虛弱和缺食物，所以 “stunted” 可理解為長期缺乏營養造成的發育受阻。題目用 malnourished 作概括，推論距離短。
About half= close to half children aged under 5= children under five malnourished= stunted，在 chronic hunger 語境下指發育因營養不足受影響判斷：題目和原文方向一致，所以答案是 TRUE。
原文沒有直接用 “malnourished” 描述這個接近一半的群體，而用了 “stunted”。但整段都在講chronic hunger 對兒童的長期影響，因此題目的改寫可以接受。

paragraphOverview.title: 全文 Skim Roadmap：只看每段首尾句後的合理段落地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: A 段首句說 southern Africa 再次面對嚴重 food crisis，而且這是長期問題；尾句說下一次收成還要等六個月。只看首尾句，可以先估計這段是危機開場，用 Malawi 一名兒童和家庭失收作具體例子，讓讀者看到糧食短缺已造成兒童營養不良，也暗示問題會持續到下一次 harvest。
B 段首句說援助機構正在發出警報，希望援助在電視出現飢餓兒童畫面前到來；尾句說 maize 變得稀少，市價已超出最飢餓者能負擔的水平。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會交代危機規模、受影響國家、需要多少援助金額，以及 drought、rain、seeds、fertiliser 和 staple food 價格如何加劇問題。
C 段首句說今年情況特別嚴重，但這個問題在 southern Africa 反覆出現；尾句說該地區有全球最高 AIDS 比率。只看首尾句，可以先估計這段會解釋長期糧食短缺的結構性原因，包括小農依賴雨水、沒有灌溉、道路和運輸差、銷售渠道不足、maize 不適合氣候、人口壓力、農法問題和疾病負擔。
D 段首句說很多小農即使在好年份也只能勉強維持生活，一個壞季節已足以造成災難；尾句說有些人冒險到有鱷魚的河流挖 water-lily tubers 充飢。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會講農民在連續乾旱和沒有資產後的絕望應對，例如賣柴、破壞土壤、在枯竭水域捕魚，以及冒生命危險尋找野生食物。
E 段首句說糟糕的政府政策有時會令問題惡化；尾句說 World Bank 將提供 3,000 萬美元。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會比較不同政府的處理方式，重點先放在 Zimbabwe 的土地、通脹、外匯、燃料、城市清拆和拒絕 UN emergency programme，再轉到 Malawi 願意尋求援助和國際資金。
F 段首句說善用該地區已經擁有的資源，能大大抵消長期飢餓；尾句說幾公里外的土地卻仍乾枯荒蕪。只看首尾句，可以估計這段會展示 irrigation 的解決潛力。它大概會用南 Malawi 的河流、糖廠綠洲和 Chitsukwa 小型灌溉計劃作例子，說明低成本水利設施如何提高產量。
G 段首句說 Malawi 農業及糧食安全部長 Uladi Mussa 堅持擴大小型灌溉是首要任務；尾句說兒童所受損害會在雨季回來後仍然持續。只看首尾句，可以估計這段先講未來解方和限制，例如know-how、money、外來農民技術，後面再轉向長期後果：兒童發育遲滯、學校出席率下降和下一代受損。
